title: Loma Caldera eruption buries Cerén
description: A volcanic eruption buries a Maya farming village so fast that its houses and crops survive, the ‘Pompeii of the Americas’.

title: Battle of Acajutla
description: Pipil warriors under King Atlácatl defeat Pedro de Alvarado's first attempt to conquer Cuzcatlán.

title: San Salvador founded
description: Spanish settlers found the town that becomes the capital.

title: First cry of independence
description: José Matías Delgado rings the bells of San Salvador to start the first rising against Spain in Central America.

title: Independent republic
description: As the federation dissolves, El Salvador gains recognition as an independent republic.

title: Battle of Chalchuapa
description: Guatemala's president dies leading troops sent to reunite Central America by force, ending the attempt.

title: Military coup
description: Army officers overthrow the elected president and install General Maximiliano Hernández Martínez, beginning half a century of military rule.

title: La Matanza
description: The army crushes a peasant and indigenous uprising and then slaughters thousands, a wound that shapes Salvadoran politics for decades.

title: Martínez driven out
description: A non-violent general strike, the ‘huelga de brazos caídos’, brings down the thirteen-year dictatorship.

title: Election fraud
description: The military steals the presidential election from José Napoleón Duarte and exiles him, closing off peaceful change and pushing opponents towards armed revolt.

title: Reformist coup
description: Young officers install a reformist junta, but the violence on both sides hardens into full civil war.

title: Archbishop Romero killed
description: Archbishop Óscar Romero is shot while saying mass, a day after calling on soldiers to disobey orders to kill.

title: El Mozote massacre
description: The army's Atlacatl Battalion kills around a thousand villagers, the largest civilian massacre of the civil war.

title: Duarte elected president
description: José Napoleón Duarte becomes the first civilian president of the war years.

title: San Salvador earthquake
description: A shallow earthquake razes parts of the capital and kills about 1,500 people.

title: Jesuits murdered
description: Soldiers murder six Jesuit priests and two women at the Central American University during the guerrillas' biggest offensive, turning world opinion against the government.

title: Peace accords
description: At Chapultepec Castle the government and the FMLN sign the peace that ends twelve years of civil war.

title: First post-war elections
description: The first elections after the war include the FMLN as a political party.

title: January earthquake
description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake and a second shock a month later kill about 1,200 people, many in a single landslide.

title: FMLN wins the presidency
description: Former guerrillas win the presidency peacefully under Mauricio Funes, ending two decades of ARENA rule.

title: Romero beatified
description: Hundreds of thousands gather as the murdered archbishop is declared blessed, three years before his canonisation.

title: Bukele elected
description: Nayib Bukele wins the presidency in the first round, breaking the two-party system that survived the peace accords.
